key_idea: Show that relative generators form a dense G_delta set via uniform perturbations from ultrapower free Haar unitaries, then elegantly reduce the resulting four generators to two using a 2x2 matrix spectral gap trick.
reason: The argument tackles a notoriously difficult problem with surprisingly light machinery and no brute force. It masterfully bridges a conceptual topological/probabilistic existence argument with a striking, elementary algebraic trick, making the final result feel inevitable.
recognized: Every type II_1 factor with separable predual is generated by two self-adjoint elements
